title: Fourier heat conduction → Fick diffusion
proposed_claim: Transfer linear flux-gradient plus conservation structure to derive a diffusion law for concentration with target-specific diffusivity.
rationale: The transport structure is formally valid; target coefficients and molecular mechanism are separately grounded rather than copied from heat. Historically productive and empirically validated in appropriate regimes.
reference: A. Fick (1855), On Liquid Diffusion; historical relation to Fourier conduction.

title: Electrical circuit → excitable membrane model
proposed_claim: Represent membrane capacitance and ionic pathways as circuit elements with voltage-dependent conductances to predict membrane current and action-potential behavior.
rationale: The electrical quantities are physically instantiated in the membrane model and the model generated quantitative predictions validated against electrophysiology.
reference: Hodgkin & Huxley (1952), J Physiol 117:500–544.

title: Reaction–diffusion chemistry → biological morphogenesis
proposed_claim: A coupled reaction–diffusion system of morphogens can destabilize a homogeneous state and generate spatial biological patterns.
rationale: Turing transferred known physical laws into a target biological mechanism with explicit equations, instability conditions, and pattern predictions; later systems provide experimental validation, though not every biological pattern is Turing-driven.
reference: A. M. Turing (1952), The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis.

title: Stochastic diffusion mathematics → Black–Scholes option pricing
proposed_claim: Use stochastic diffusion and no-arbitrage assumptions to derive an option-pricing PDE; treat volatility and market parameters as target quantities rather than copied physical constants.
primary_fail: PO08 if literal physical Brownian mechanism were claimed
rationale: The formal stochastic transfer is legitimate under explicit market assumptions. It is not a claim that financial prices have the same microscopic mechanism as molecules.
reference: Black & Scholes (1973); Merton (1973).

title: Statistical-physics energy landscape → Hopfield associative memory
proposed_claim: Construct a symmetric recurrent network with an energy/Lyapunov function whose attractor minima encode content-addressable memories.
rationale: The energy formalism is mathematically defined for the target network and predicts attractor behavior; no claim is required that artificial units are literal spins or biological neurons.

title: Momentum/heat transfer → mass-transfer j-factor analogy
proposed_claim: Transfer dimensionless transport structure between momentum, heat, and mass transfer under declared turbulent-flow regimes to estimate target transfer coefficients.
rationale: Dimensionless groups and boundary-layer structure support the analogy only within specified regimes; target coefficients are not raw copies.
reference: Chilton & Colburn, 1930s j-factor analogy; ASME/Industrial & Engineering Chemistry literature.

title: Geometrical optics → Hamilton–Jacobi mechanics
proposed_claim: Transfer the variational/eikonal structure of rays and wavefronts to trajectories and action surfaces in mechanics.
rationale: The optico-mechanical analogy preserves a deep mathematical structure and historically supported further theoretical development. It need not imply that mechanical particles are literally light rays.
reference: Hamilton, 19th-century optical-mechanical analogy; later Hamilton–Jacobi theory.

title: Feedback control theory → closed-loop insulin delivery
proposed_claim: Use feedback/model-predictive control to adjust insulin delivery from glucose sensor measurements within physiological and safety constraints.
rationale: The control structure is instantiated in a real sensor-controller-actuator loop and has been experimentally validated; physiological plant models and safety bounds remain target-specific.
reference: Randomized closed-loop insulin-delivery trials, including NEJM clinical literature.

title: Error-correcting codes → DNA digital storage
proposed_claim: Use erasure/error-correcting coding, indexing, and redundancy to make synthesized DNA a robust digital storage channel under sequencing/synthesis error constraints.
rationale: Coding theory transfers as a formal information structure while biochemical channel statistics are separately measured and encoded into the target design.
reference: Erlich & Zielinski (2017), DNA Fountain; Science 355:950–954.

title: Chemical mass-action dynamics → population interaction equations
proposed_claim: Transfer coupled nonlinear mass-action-style interaction equations to model predator–prey population dynamics, with ecological parameters estimated in target units.
primary_fail: PO08 if molecular collision mechanism is asserted literally
rationale: Lotka-style equations demonstrate a legitimate formal transfer of interaction structure; ecological mechanisms and parameters are not molecular identities.
reference: Lotka early chemical-kinetic work and Lotka–Volterra population models.

title: Solar system → classical atom
proposed_claim: Because planets orbit a central mass and electrons are attracted to a nucleus, use classical planetary orbits as the physical mechanism of stable atoms.
rationale: A limited center–orbit analogy exists, but classical electrodynamics and quantum evidence block the mechanistic promotion.
reference: Canonical Bohr/quantum transition; used as a benchmark anti-example.

title: Electrostatic shielding → gravitational Faraday cage
proposed_claim: Weak-field gravity has equations reminiscent of electromagnetism; therefore a conducting shell should shield a gravitational field like a Faraday cage shields electrostatics.
primary_pass: PO03 only within bounded weak-field formal analogy
rationale: Formal gravitoelectromagnetic analogies do not supply electric-charge sign structure or conductor rearrangement that produces electrostatic shielding.
reference: Weak-field GR / gravitoelectromagnetism benchmark case.

title: Shannon entropy → intrinsic energy per bit
proposed_claim: Because Shannon entropy and thermodynamic entropy share a mathematical form, every stored bit intrinsically contains kT ln 2 of recoverable thermal energy.
rationale: Information entropy and thermodynamic entropy can be linked in physical information processing, but Landauer-type energetic costs concern physical operations/implementations, not an automatic energy substance stored in an abstract bit.
reference: Shannon information theory; Landauer principle used to distinguish formal and physical claims.

title: Fluid vortex → literal electron vortex
proposed_claim: Stable vortices persist in fluids, therefore electrons are literally tiny vortices in a hidden mechanical medium and inherit vortex mechanics.
primary_pass: PO03 for selected topology metaphor only
rationale: A topological analogy does not establish a hidden medium or particle mechanism; target evidence and mechanism are missing.
reference: Historical vortex-atom style ideas as an anti-example.

title: Software code → genetic code as executable program semantics
proposed_claim: DNA is called code, therefore genes execute like software instructions with programmer-defined semantics and mutations should be analyzed as software bugs.
rationale: Both domains use symbolic sequences, but biochemical regulation, development, redundancy, context, and causation do not preserve ordinary software execution semantics.
reference: Benchmark constructed from common public analogy.

title: Quantum tunneling → human choice mechanism
proposed_claim: People sometimes cross psychological barriers unexpectedly, so quantum tunneling is the physical mechanism by which decisions escape local mental minima.
rationale: The shared word “barrier” and landscape imagery do not provide a preserved quantum relation or a biophysical tunneling mechanism for cognition.
reference: Synthetic benchmark anti-example.

title: Artificial neural network → literal biological-brain mechanism
proposed_claim: A transformer or artificial neural network learns useful representations, therefore its internal units and attention mechanisms are the same causal mechanism used by biological brains.
rationale: Functional similarity or shared optimization language does not establish biological mechanistic identity.
reference: Synthetic benchmark based on common AI/neuroscience overclaim.

title: SIR epidemic model → exact meme contagion biology
proposed_claim: Because posts spread through social contact, reuse an SIR model unchanged and interpret reshares as infections, non-sharing as immunity, and the fitted R0 as a biological-style reproduction constant.
primary_pass: PO03,PO04 if explicitly treated as a formal compartment model
rationale: Compartment equations may be useful target models, but recovery, immunity, contact structure, repeated exposure, and incentives differ and must be redefined/validated.
reference: Synthetic benchmark representing common computational-social-science model transfer.

title: Acoustic horizon → full astrophysical black hole
proposed_claim: A sonic horizon reproduces horizon-like wave kinematics, therefore the laboratory fluid is physically equivalent to an astrophysical black hole and tests the full Einstein gravitational dynamics.
rationale: Analogue-gravity systems can reproduce selected effective-metric or horizon kinematics without reproducing the full dynamical field equations or gravitational source structure.
reference: Analogue-gravity benchmark case.

title: Thermodynamic equilibrium → market equilibrium as physical law
proposed_claim: Markets have equilibria, so prices and trades should obey thermodynamic temperature, energy conservation, and entropy production as literal physical state laws.
primary_pass: PO01,PO03 only for selected optimization/statistical analogies
rationale: Mathematical methods from statistical mechanics can model economic data, but that does not make money physical energy or market clearing thermodynamic equilibrium.
reference: Synthetic benchmark anti-example.
